emailAndSpread.title: Email & Spread Size
emailAndSpread.description:
Keep your email up to date for account notifications.

Set a Spread Size Threshold — only spreads above this % will be shown and flagged as opportunities. Example: 0.5 means you only care about spreads ≥ 0.5%.

positionSize.title: Position Size
positionSize.description: Choose your trading position size — this is the dollar amount per trade leg. It is used to estimate your potential profit for each spread opportunity. Pick an amount that matches your risk tolerance.

monitoring.title: Monitoring Preferences
monitoring.description: Toggle which spread types you want to track: Futures, Funding, or Spot. Select only the types you actively trade to reduce noise and focus on relevant opportunities.

exchanges.title: Active Exchanges
exchanges.description: Choose which exchanges to monitor. Only pairs involving your selected exchanges will be included in the live spread feed. Deselect exchanges you do not have accounts on.

telegram.title: Telegram Notifications
telegram.description: Connect your Telegram account to receive instant alerts when spreads matching your criteria appear. Click "Link Telegram" and follow the bot instructions. You can unlink at any time from this page.

emailChangeDialog.title: Confirm Email Change
emailChangeDialog.body: To use <bold>{{email}}</bold> to sign in next time, you need to confirm it first. A confirmation code will be sent to this address.

header.title: Account Settings
header.subtitle: Manage your profile, trading preferences, and exchange connections.

none.title: No Active Subscription
none.body: You don't currently have an active subscription. Explore our available options to unlock premium features.

notConnected.label: Connect Telegram
notConnected.description: Link your Telegram account to receive instant notifications about trading opportunities.
